Give each level a regulatory node bounded by law
Let banking growth fall to zero and rank the marginal gains

warnings.warning: The currency-value derivation is watermark-flattened and the lines of equation (5) run together. The reading follows the prose, which says value rises with income and falls as velocity rises.
The stability-return fraction in equation (6) is split across lines and the acceptance symbol collides with the efficiency symbol. The weighted-change reading follows the definition given beside it.
The net-income double sum in equation (25) has its indices displaced, and the membership matrices are only partly legible. The weights are taken from the printed results, not recomputed.
Equation (33) prints the small-country identity twice with overlapping symbols. It is read once, as net exports equal saving minus investment.
The banking growth equations (34) to (38) scramble the derivative notation and the slope definition. The linear decline that hits zero at terminal acceptance follows the prose.
The derivative matrix (43) is badly flattened and its rows do not line up with equations (40) to (42). The ranking is taken from the authors' own reading of it.
Section 5 prints no equation. The node hierarchy is reconstructed from the prose and should not be treated as a printed formula.
